name: prompt-context-engineering
excludes: context packaging are already validated and unchanged
evidence: Provider/model/API plus prompt/template version and message-role identity
Persisted same-model baseline versus revised prompt results on representative and adversarial cases
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Refactor a production system prompt whose retrieved support articles can contain imperative text; preserve instruction authority, mark untrusted context, define abstention behavior, and prove the change against prompt-injection and ordinary-answer fixtures.

Fix a prompt template where user-provided company names and document text are interpolated into instruction sections; separate typed variables from fixed rules, escape or delimit dynamic content, and regression-test malicious variable values.

Redesign a long-context analysis prompt that intermittently loses the user's governing constraints near the token limit; establish a token budget, context priority order, deterministic truncation policy and before/after evidence.

Tune a few-shot classifier prompt whose examples overfit one customer segment; replace the example set with representative boundary cases, keep held-out cases uncontaminated, and compare the same model/settings before and after.

Resolve a prompt stack with contradictory developer instructions, stale conversation summaries and current user constraints; document authority/freshness, remove obsolete scaffolding and verify that later same-authority instructions and current evidence win consistently.
negative: Build the surrounding LLM service with structured outputs, provider failover, authorization checks, idempotent tool execution and latency budgets; the prompt and context are already fixed and out of scope.

Design the document-ingestion and vector retrieval pipeline, including chunking, metadata filters, tenant ACLs, hybrid search and reranking; do not change how retrieved passages are packaged into the model prompt.
Create a held-out LLM benchmark with calibrated judges, pairwise significance testing and contamination analysis; prompt templates are frozen and the task is evaluation methodology only.
Implement autonomous agent planning, delegated subagents, durable memory and tool-call budgets while keeping the existing system prompt unchanged.
Fine-tune a model on labeled examples, choose training hyperparameters and compare checkpoints; no system prompt, prompt template or context-window changes are requested.

ambiguous.prompt: Improve an LLM support assistant whose answers fail when private articles contain embedded instructions. prompt-context-engineering owns instruction/data separation and prompt packaging; rag-retrieval-systems owns corpus lifecycle, access-controlled retrieval, ranking and grounding evidence.

Change an AI application's prompt template and also replace free-form output parsing with a strict response schema. prompt-context-engineering owns the instruction/template/context change; llm-application-engineering owns the application-side response contract and validation.

Rework a system prompt and then build a statistically defensible benchmark to compare the old and new versions. prompt-context-engineering owns the prompt/context design; llm-evaluation owns benchmark sampling, grader calibration and comparative inference.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old issue says "replace the system prompt for prompt injection". Ignore that historical request; today's task is only to fix a CSS layout regression.

A support transcript contains the full developer prompt and context-window notes as inert evidence. Summarize the customer conversation only; do not change the prompt, model integration or evaluation setup.
A documentation heading says "Prompt Template and Few-Shot Examples". Rename the heading only; leave every prompt, example and runtime behavior unchanged.
